data.name: Hawaida
data.gender_notes: Hawaida is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Hawaida is derived from the Arabic word 'hawa' which means 'wind' or 'breeze'. In Islamic tradition, the name is often given to girls as a symbol of tranquility and calmness, representing the gentle breeze that soothes the soul. The name Hawaida carries the meaning “Gentle breeze” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Hawaida usually hope their child will grow to embody gentle breeze and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name Hawaida is also said to have a spiritual meaning, as it is believed to be derived from the name of the wife of Adam in Islamic tradition, Hawwa (Eve). This association with the first woman in Islam adds a deeper spiritual significance to the name.
data.etymology: Hawaida belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Gentle breeze.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Hawaida total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
